rules.title: Audience/context explicit
rules.requirement: The intended evaluator or audience and what they need to understand are explicit.
expectations: Audience/context is documented before visual composition.

rules.title: First impression explicit
rules.requirement: The intended first-impression sentence for the opening seconds is documented.
expectations: A concrete intended first impression is present.

rules.title: Website archetype explicit
rules.requirement: The website archetype is explicit.
expectations: A website type/archetype is resolved.

rules.title: Vertical and page roles explicit
rules.requirement: Vertical/sub-industry and representative page roles are explicit.
expectations: A vertical is resolved or explicitly unknown.
Representative page roles are identified.

rules.title: Exactly three style adjectives
rules.requirement: Exactly three useful style adjectives guide visual decisions.
expectations: Three distinct style adjectives are documented.

rules.title: Demo path explicit
rules.requirement: One representative demo path from entry to completion is identified.
expectations: A start, meaningful path and completion state are documented.

rules.title: Signature moment explicit
rules.requirement: One signature or hero moment is identified for disproportionate craft.
rules.applicability: Visual prototypes where a signature moment supports the brand.
expectations: A concrete signature moment is documented.

rules.title: Content and media reality
rules.requirement: Content/media reality and important unknowns are documented.
expectations: Known assets/content and important gaps are recorded.

rules.title: Research informs composition
rules.requirement: Domain/reference research materially informs composition rather than a universal template.
expectations: Reference/domain evidence is traceable into composition decisions.

rules.title: Choice complexity controlled
rules.requirement: Competing choices are reduced or grouped when scanning would otherwise become difficult.
expectations: Choice density does not obscure the primary decision.

rules.title: Targets easy to acquire
rules.requirement: Primary controls are easy to acquire and appropriately sized for the tested viewport.
expectations: No obvious control target falls below the active minimum target-size policy.

rules.title: Familiar interaction grammar
rules.requirement: Conventional navigation, forms, search and transaction patterns are preserved unless deviation has evidence.
rules.applicability: Pages using familiar web interaction patterns.
expectations: Visible interaction grammar is comprehensible for the page role.

rules.title: Grouping communicates relationships
rules.requirement: Proximity, similarity and alignment reveal related information without unnecessary explanation.
expectations: Grouping supports hierarchy and page-role comprehension.

rules.title: Primary decision object wins
rules.requirement: One primary action or decision object visually wins where a decision is required.
expectations: Decision-object dominance meets the active domain policy.

rules.title: Visible feedback
rules.requirement: Clicks, submits, toggles and validation provide visible feedback.
expectations: Each tested action produces an observable state response.

rules.title: Multi-step progress visible
rules.requirement: Multi-step flows show state or progress when it reduces uncertainty.
expectations: Current state/progress is visible when applicable.

rules.title: Interaction response timing
rules.requirement: Interactive feedback is timely under the configured prototype performance policy.
rules.applicability: Interactive controls in the representative demo path.
expectations: Measured interaction-to-visible-feedback meets the configured lab threshold.

rules.title: Aesthetics do not conceal flow
rules.requirement: Visual polish does not conceal a confusing task flow.
expectations: Page-role fit and hierarchy remain adequate while completing the flow.

rules.title: Primary and destructive actions separated
rules.requirement: Primary controls are visually and spatially separated from destructive or secondary actions.
rules.applicability: Routes containing destructive or secondary actions near a primary action.
expectations: Action hierarchy and separation are visibly clear.

rules.title: Colour roles defined
rules.requirement: Primary, supporting, neutral and semantic colour roles are defined where applicable.
expectations: Colour roles are represented in the design system.

rules.title: Accent colour disciplined
rules.requirement: Accent colour is used intentionally rather than making every component compete.
expectations: Accent usage supports rather than flattens hierarchy.

rules.title: Readable contrast smoke
rules.requirement: Rendered text and controls avoid catastrophic contrast failures in automated smoke checks.
expectations: Catastrophic contrast smoke count is zero.

rules.title: Typography supports style direction
rules.requirement: Typography visibly supports the chosen style adjectives and hierarchy.
expectations: Typography is coherent with the documented art direction.

rules.title: Font system restrained
rules.requirement: Typefaces are added only for clear roles and the font system remains restrained.
expectations: Font-family count and roles meet the configured design-system policy.

rules.title: Type scale and line-height coherent
rules.requirement: Type scale and line-height form a coherent hierarchy.
expectations: Computed typography does not violate configured scale/line-height constraints.

rules.title: Long-form measure controlled
rules.requirement: Long-form body copy uses a readable measure appropriate to the context.
expectations: Text measure is not visibly or measurably excessive.

rules.title: Alignment and spacing rhythm coherent
rules.requirement: Shared alignment and spacing rhythm are coherent across representative pages.
expectations: Spacing/alignment supports hierarchy without arbitrary drift.

rules.title: Whitespace intentional
rules.requirement: Whitespace improves hierarchy rather than creating empty premium-looking regions without purpose.
expectations: Whitespace is visually justified by composition and hierarchy.

rules.title: Squint hierarchy correct
rules.requirement: After blur/squint transformation the intended first, second and third visual priorities remain correct.
expectations: Blurred screenshot ranking matches intended decision order.

rules.title: Page roles compositionally distinct
rules.requirement: Materially different page roles use composition appropriate to their different user tasks.
rules.applicability: Multi-page sites with materially different page roles.
expectations: Cross-route variety meets the active domain policy.

rules.title: Media has a job
rules.requirement: Images, illustrations and icons are domain/content relevant and share intentional art direction.
expectations: Media relevance meets the active domain policy.

rules.title: Media crops preserve focal subjects
rules.requirement: Rendered media crops preserve focal subjects at representative breakpoints.
rules.applicability: Responsive routes with photographic or illustrative media.
expectations: No representative viewport damages the focal subject.

rules.title: Project-specific visual signature
rules.requirement: The prototype contains a memorable brief-specific visual signature when appropriate.
expectations: Visible distinctiveness and brand distinctiveness meet the active policy.

rules.title: Primary motion moment polished
rules.requirement: One primary motion or signature interaction receives the highest polish where motion is used.
expectations: A primary motion moment is demonstrable and aligned with art direction.

rules.title: Hover press focus states
rules.requirement: Hover, pressed and focus-visible states exist for interactive controls used in the demo.
rules.applicability: Interactive controls in the representative demo path.
expectations: Each applicable control exposes the tested states.

rules.title: Transition timing intentional
rules.requirement: UI transition timing is deliberate and avoids sluggish or indiscriminate animation.
expectations: Measured transitions meet the configured prototype timing policy.

rules.title: No repetitive generic scroll animation
rules.requirement: Broad identical scroll-triggered animation is not applied indiscriminately to every section.
expectations: Motion variety/rationale is consistent with the art direction.

rules.title: Loading success error validation visible
rules.requirement: Loading, success, error and validation feedback are visible when the demo path invokes them.
rules.applicability: Demo paths with waiting, forms or fallible actions.
expectations: Every applicable feedback state is observable.

rules.title: Reduced motion respected
rules.requirement: Material motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
expectations: Reduced-motion rendering removes or reduces nonessential motion.

rules.title: Custom effects justified
rules.requirement: Custom cursor, parallax or comparable effects have a clear rationale and do not reduce control.
rules.applicability: Prototypes using custom cursor, parallax or comparable effects.
expectations: Effects support the experience and do not obscure interaction.

rules.title: Default hover focus selected disabled completeness
rules.requirement: Every representative component exposes all applicable default, hover/pressed, focus-visible, selected/active and disabled states.
expectations: Applicable core states are reachable and visually distinct.

rules.title: Loading states complete
rules.requirement: Components that wait expose an appropriate loading state.
rules.applicability: Components with asynchronous or simulated waiting.
expectations: Loading state is reachable and visible.

rules.title: Empty/no-results states complete
rules.requirement: Lists or searches that can be empty expose an appropriate empty/no-results state.
expectations: Empty/no-results state is reachable and comprehensible.

rules.title: Error and success states complete
rules.requirement: Forms and fallible actions expose appropriate error and success states.
expectations: Error and success states are both demonstrable where applicable.

rules.title: Representative widths rendered
rules.requirement: Responsive prototypes are inspected at representative mobile, tablet and desktop widths.
expectations: Representative browser screenshots exist for mobile, tablet and desktop.

rules.title: Responsive transformation usable
rules.requirement: Content priority, navigation, filters, media crops and control reachability transform intentionally across devices.
expectations: Responsive visual score and route evidence show no material degradation.

rules.title: Preferred prototype touch targets
rules.requirement: Important touch controls target approximately 44 by 44 CSS px or larger when space allows.
expectations: Important mobile controls meet the preferred prototype target-size policy or carry an explicit exception.

rules.title: Content stress survives responsive layouts
rules.requirement: Long names, large values and Vietnamese/translated content do not break representative responsive layouts.
expectations: Stress fixtures produce no overflow, clipping or critical hierarchy break.

rules.title: Squint test performed
rules.requirement: Representative screens receive a blur/squint review that records first, second and third visual priorities.
expectations: Squint evidence exists for every representative route.

rules.title: Blind 5-second comprehension tested
rules.requirement: A blind screenshot review can identify what the site is, who it is for and the primary next action without receiving the design brief.
expectations: Blind review matches intended site identity, audience and primary action.

rules.title: Remove-one-decoration pass
rules.requirement: At least one decorative element is challenged for removal, or visual density is explicitly justified.
expectations: A concrete remove/retain decision is documented.

rules.title: Style-word check
rules.requirement: Rendered evidence is compared against the three style adjectives using type, colour, media, spacing and motion.
expectations: Concrete visible evidence supports each style adjective.

rules.title: Competitive distinctiveness checked
rules.requirement: Representative screenshots are compared with selected production references for project-specific distinctiveness without harming task clarity.
expectations: Distinctiveness evidence is explicit and not based on decoration alone.

rules.title: Real interaction pass
rules.requirement: The representative demo path is completed with real browser interaction and keyboard/touch emulation where relevant.
expectations: Trace proves completion of the documented demo path.

rules.title: Content stress pass
rules.requirement: Realistic copy, Vietnamese diacritics, long names, large values and edge-case labels are pressure-tested where applicable.
expectations: Stress variants do not break layout or comprehension.

rules.title: Independent human review
rules.requirement: At least one other person reviews the representative prototype and supplies feedback before final approval.
expectations: An independent human review artifact exists and records reviewer feedback/decision.
